assets: independence of the two reviewer trust domains
trust_boundaries: untrusted assertion envelope to verifier parser
verifier process or workload to result consumer
build system and provenance signer to verifier allowlist
credential and revocation administration to verifier
result consumer to replay and evidence ledger
each reviewer domain to the other reviewer domain
attacker_capabilities: supply malformed or oversized assertion and result bytes
replay a valid assertion, result, nonce or evidence ID
substitute RP ID, origin, challenge, credential root, epoch, policy or build digest
compromise one reviewer, one builder, one verifier host or one result-signing key
serve stale revocation or allowlist state
present valid provenance for a non-reproducible or non-executed artifact
exploit parser disagreement between producer and consumer

abuse_cases.attack: submit a structurally all-green unsigned verifier result
abuse_cases.required_control: authenticate the exact closed result bytes under a separately pinned mechanism

abuse_cases.attack: name an attacker build digest in an otherwise authentic result
abuse_cases.required_control: consumer-selected build allowlist plus provenance and independent reproducibility

abuse_cases.attack: a valid result-signing key signs output from a modified verifier
abuse_cases.required_control: cross-bind authenticated result to verified build and policy digests

abuse_cases.attack: use valid SLSA provenance as proof that the named artifact executed correctly
abuse_cases.required_control: treat provenance, reproducibility and execution identity as separate checks

abuse_cases.attack: reuse old valid evidence with a stale but once-valid revocation epoch
abuse_cases.required_control: caller nonce, bounded lifetime, monotonic epoch and atomic single-use ledger

abuse_cases.attack: make verifier and consumer interpret result, Base64URL or client data differently
abuse_cases.required_control: exact-byte digest binding, closed models, canonical decoding and shared mutation corpus

abuse_cases.attack: reuse credential, recovery, verifier or build roots across nominally independent reviewers
abuse_cases.required_control: reject shared credential, recovery, verifier administration and build trust roots

abuse_cases.attack: forge IPC or modify dependencies/configuration around an allowlisted binary
abuse_cases.required_control: private authenticated process boundary or measured workload with explicit configuration coverage

out_of_scope: proving the WebAuthn specification or ES256 primitive correct
protecting a reviewer whose authenticator and UV secret are both compromised
authorizing production wallet signing or any customer action
blockers: verifier build identity and allowlist source not selected
independent verifier administration and recovery roots not defined
no real verifier build, assertion, credential, result or replay ledger exists
